help.file: the .stl model (absolute path, or relative to this file); binary or ASCII STL, z-up
help.lon, lat: the real longitude/latitude of the model's centre
help.height_m: the model height in blocks (the real height of the landmark)
help.material: the block the model is built of (minecraft:...) — any block name, also one that is not in the built-in palette
help.yaw: rotation around the up axis, degrees, clockwise as seen from above (0 — as the model lies in the file)
help.placement: "roof" (default) — when the centre falls on a building, the model stands on its roof; "instead" — that building is razed and the model stands on the lot
help.attribution: the credit line of the model, written into the world's ATTRIBUTION.txt
